rules.name: grasa-sip-mult-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT trade_id, product_code, security_id, contract_month, active_lots, lot_mult1, curr_mult1, nc_factor1 FROM dbsystemuat.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE SUBSTRING(contract_number, 1, 3) = :client AND product_code IN ('CM OR', 'CM OR EUR')

SELECT trade_id, product_code, security_id, contract_month, active_lots, lot_mult1, curr_mult1, nc_factor1 FROM opera.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND upper(trim(business_unit)) = :bu AND upper(substring(contract_number, 1, 3)) = :client AND product_code IN ('CM OR', 'CM OR EUR')
